install_tell: pip install metagpt  (CLI: metagpt 'your requirement'; no web server, no socket bind, no EXPOSE in Dockerfile)
misconfig_patterns: Provider API keys committed to config/config2.yaml or ~/.metagpt/config2.yaml in public repos -- primary exposure vector (no web service to scan, only leaked-file route)
config2.yaml llm.api_key field holds raw provider key (OpenAI sk-/sk-proj-, openrouter sk-or-v1-, deepseek/moonshot/dashscope-class) -- LLMjacking direct from committed config
config2.example.yaml placeholder (YOUR_API_KEY) is the negative-control anchor -- gate on entropy+prefix to strip placeholders
CVE-2024-23750 (<=0.6.6): OS command injection in RunCode action at runtime -- not a web-service CVE but applies to any execution environment

active_probe.false_positive_check: No HTTP listener -- fingerprinting is GitHub code-search only (leaked-file route). Active probe not applicable. Negative-control: exclude any hit where api_key value matches YOUR_API_KEY/sk-xxx/example placeholder; require Shannon entropy >= 3.2 + min 12 distinct chars + known provider prefix for high-confidence call.  cat-agent-platforms 2026-06-19 round-2: 148 hits inspected -> 17 non-placeholder keys (12 prefixed high/med + 5 opaque).

shodan_dorks.note: http.html:"metagpt" = 3 hits (near-zero -- CLI tool, no web service). Shodan fingerprinting not viable at scale. Primary discovery route is GitHub code-search for committed config2.yaml keys: filename:config2.yaml "api_key:" NOT "YOUR_API_KEY". Negative-control gate required -- placeholder majority dominates raw hits.

deployment_tells: No web listener -- no port, no socket, Dockerfile CMD is 'tail -f /dev/null' with no EXPOSE
config2.yaml or ~/.metagpt/config2.yaml present with llm.api_type and llm.api_key fields
GitHub repos containing committed config2.yaml with non-placeholder api_key values
pivot_paths: GitHub code search: filename:config2.yaml "api_key:" NOT "YOUR_API_KEY" -- enumerate committed provider keys
filename:config2.yaml "api_type:" "base_url:" NOT "YOUR_API_KEY" -- strict version with provider confirmation
Entropy + provider-prefix gate on extracted values before asserting key material
vulnerabilities: CVE-2024-23750 (CVSS unscored, affects <=0.6.6): OS command injection in RunCode action -- attacker-controlled code passed to execution environment without sanitization.
auth_evidence: No authentication surface -- MetaGPT is a CLI library with no HTTP listener. The sole exposure vector is committed config2.yaml containing provider API keys in public repositories.  cat-agent-platforms survey 2026-06-19 round-2: 148 GitHub repos inspected, 17 with non-placeholder provider keys committed. Placeholder majority dominated by config2.example.yaml echoes.
sensitive_assets: Provider API keys in committed config2.yaml (OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Moonshot, DashScope, Anthropic) -- LLMjacking primitive
LLM base_url overrides in config2.yaml (reveals internal or proxy LLM endpoints)
